messages:
jia_metrics: FYI - Prometheus exploded at ~02:14 UTC. We saw a huge cardinality spike from embed_vector_length labels, ~180k new series in an hour :grimacing:
sam_runtime: ouch. Any idea which change caused it?
jia_metrics: the per-dim label experiment. Mixed-dim batches meant each (tenant,route,dim) emitted its own series. Prom couldn't handle it.
metrics-bot: ALERT: prometheus-cluster-2 series_count > 150k at 02:14 UTC :rotating_light:
oscar_frontend: dashboards became unusable. Graphs missing, queries time out.
maya_prod: we need a pragmatic plan: short-term ingestion controls + a longer-term telemetry design that preserves percentiles but avoids label explosion.
sam_runtime: short-term technical move: runtime will stop creating arbitrary dim labels and add an ingress sampler that limits new label emission to N per minute. Excess dims get `dim=overflow`. Cheap to ship.
jia_metrics: sampling helps alert fatigue, but we still want percentile accuracy. Idea: emit low-cardinality metrics for Prom and ship compressed sketches to a metrics service (DDSketch). Console reads precomputed p50/p90/p99 from that service.
infra_oncall: adding a new store is friction. Can we instead have a sidecar collector that receives sketches and writes derived numeric series back into Prom remote-write?
oscar_frontend: console can display sketch-derived percentiles; we should show confidence / error bounds so customers understand approximation.
maya_prod: product ops: add a console toggle: default "Sketch-derived percentiles" and opt-in "Show sampled per-dim". That keeps UX predictable and allows power users to dive deeper.
sam_runtime: implementation sketch: 1) ingress sampler + tag overflow; 2) runtime encodes DDSketch per tenant+route and streams to metrics-collector over gRPC; 3) collector materializes numeric timeseries for p50/p90/p99 into Prom.
jia_metrics: avoid storing blobs in Prom. Collector should own sketches and only emit numeric aggregates. We'll also keep top-K reservoir sampled dims for an opt-in dim explorer stored in ClickHouse.
oscar_frontend: UI asks: how do we surface sampling rate and error?
maya_prod: show sampling rate, bucket counts, and DDSketch error bound. Expose a tooltip that explains relative error.
sam_runtime: we also need an official client header for shape hints. Propose: `X-Embed-Shape: dims=768;batch=5`. Runtime will use it for fastpath routing but will validate against actual payload.
jia_metrics: header must be optional and never trusted for billing or routing without validation. We'll track header adherence in telemetry for SDK authors.
infra_oncall: collector ownership? Metrics team should operate it, infra provides SRE/runbook.
maya_prod: owners: sam -> runtime changes + header validation PR; jia -> collector proto + design doc; oscar -> console mockups + sampling control; infra_oncall -> capacity/runbook.
oscar_frontend: I'll prototype mockups by Friday and include error visuals.
sam_runtime: I'll ship ingress sampler behind a feature flag today and follow up with gRPC sketch export.
jia_metrics: starting the design doc in #eng-platform. Tagging folks: @sam_runtime @oscar_frontend @infra_oncall if you want to review.
maya_prod: thanks everyone. Let's try to avoid another midnight pager. :thumbsup:
